name: order_stool_culture
description: Orders a stool culture for identification of enteric bacterial pathogens including Salmonella, Shigella, Campylobacter, E. coli O157:H7, and Yersinia. Includes antibiotic sensitivity testing.

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering stool culture

include_c_difficile.description: Whether to include Clostridioides difficile toxin assay

include_ova_parasites.description: Whether to include ova and parasite examination

include_giardia_antigen.description: Whether to include Giardia antigen test

when_to_use: Diarrhea following antibiotic use (C. diff suspicion)

examples.query: Send stool for culture and C. diff toxin

args.clinical_indication: watery diarrhea after recent clindamycin course
